name: Spamhaus DROP lists
tier_rationale: Established security non-profit with published terms (A8 BR2 names Spamhaus as trusted; P149 chair: 'Spamhaus and abuse.ch are trusted').

reliability.justification: Curated lists of hijacked and criminal netblocks/ASNs maintained by Spamhaus researchers; very low false-positive rate.

drop_v4.title: Spamhaus DROP (IPv4, NDJSON)

terms.quote: Per-feed terms registry with an enable flag per feed. Open (run under corporate): Spamhaus DROP/EDROP/ASN-DROP (free for protection, no resale), Feodo Tracker and SSLBL (abuse.ch CC0, A1 BR14), IPsum (Unlicense), Binary Defense Artillery (internal use, no resale).

drop_v4.notes: Quote: binding council text (P149 cond 1); research C0346 (verified_live 200; NDJSON, last line = metadata with the terms URL). EDROP has been merged into DROP (edrop.txt is an empty stub): not fetched. Refreshed at most hourly as Spamhaus asks, matched locally. Used by ip_blocklists.
